import sys
from awsglue.utils import getResolvedOptions
from pyspark.context import SparkContext
from awsglue.context import GlueContext
from awsglue.job import Job
from pyspark.ml.feature import StringIndexer
from pyspark.sql.functions import col, coalesce, lit

args = getResolvedOptions(sys.argv, ['JOB_NAME'])

sc = SparkContext()
glueContext = GlueContext(sc)
spark = glueContext.spark_session
job = Job(glueContext)
job.init(args['JOB_NAME'], args)

bucket = "propelnoi-vijay-datalake"

train_input_path = f"s3://{bucket}/outputs/output_maintenance_training/"
score_input_path = f"s3://{bucket}/outputs/output_maintenance_scoring_input/"
infer_path = f"s3://{bucket}/modeling/maintenance_rf/inference_input/"

train_df = spark.read.parquet(train_input_path)
score_df = spark.read.parquet(score_input_path)

city_indexer = StringIndexer(inputCol="city", outputCol="city_idx", handleInvalid="keep")
ptype_indexer = StringIndexer(inputCol="property_type", outputCol="property_type_idx", handleInvalid="keep")
system_indexer = StringIndexer(inputCol="system_type", outputCol="system_type_idx", handleInvalid="keep")

city_model = city_indexer.fit(train_df)
ptype_model = ptype_indexer.fit(train_df)
system_model = system_indexer.fit(train_df)

score_df = city_model.transform(score_df)
score_df = ptype_model.transform(score_df)
score_df = system_model.transform(score_df)

final_df = score_df.select(
    coalesce(col("city_idx"), lit(0.0)).alias("city_idx"),
    coalesce(col("property_type_idx"), lit(0.0)).alias("property_type_idx"),
    coalesce(col("system_type_idx"), lit(0.0)).alias("system_type_idx"),
    coalesce(col("units"), lit(0)).alias("units"),
    coalesce(col("repair_cost"), lit(0.0)).alias("repair_cost"),
    coalesce(col("asset_age"), lit(0)).alias("asset_age"),
    coalesce(col("avg_repair_cost_3m"), lit(0.0)).alias("avg_repair_cost_3m"),
    coalesce(col("risk_score"), lit(0.0)).alias("risk_score")
)

final_df.coalesce(1).write.mode("overwrite").option("header", "false").csv(infer_path)

job.commit()
